content:
The ordinary General Assembly of CT197 BIM, the Technical Standardisation Committee (TC) for Building Information Modelling (BIM) coordinated by BUILT CoLAB as a Sectoral Standardisation Body, was held on 5 July.

This CT197 BIM meeting was attended by 40 members and experts involved in work of the existing Task Forces, and aimed to continue the close contact with Members and definition of future strategies in the standardisation landscape, both national and European.

The agenda went as follows:

. Presentation of the work developed by the TC since the last General Assembly: Translations of standards, Projects in collaboration with CT197 (SECClasS), Mobilising Project REV@CONSTRUCTION;

. Update of the list of members;

. Explanation of the mandatory interaction with the ISOlutions platform;

. Other Matters.
